band.reportHint: Opens in a new tab, as a preview
band.keepReport: Keep a version of the report

offline: Offline – the page shows its last copy; changes wait until the connection is back.

stale.title: This NCR changed at {time} while you were working on it.

activity.none: The thread, files and history open here.

problem.unitFixed: Something is decided: the unit stays.
problem.heldTitleLong: At most 160 characters in the title.
problem.heldQuantity: Say how much is affected (above 0, at most 4 decimals).
problem.heldSuspect: The suspect quantity: a number with at most 4 decimals.
problem.causeHint: From the cause list (Quality settings). Read-only once decided.
problem.causesFailed: The cause list could not be read.

fact.ppe: A PPE style: a nonconformity that may present a risk goes to the PPE register.

photos.failed: The photos could not be read.
photos.hint: Photos of the NCR itself; a containment action keeps its own evidence.
photos.notAdded_one: {count} photo was not added: try again.
photos.notAdded_other: {count} photos were not added: try again.
photos.notOpened: The photo could not be opened.

side.label: Stage and next step
side.title: Stage and next step
side.registerNone: Not in the register yet (by itself when critical or found by the customer).
side.registerNotPpe: Not a PPE style: no register entry.
side.capaElsewhere: Escalated to a CAPA you do not see

containment.intro: Immediate actions with an owner and a due time. The owner, the due time and the description save by themselves; done needs its evidence.
containment.label: Containment actions
containment.empty: No containment yet - add the first action.
containment.emptyBody: Hold the stock, check the work in progress, check what was shipped, tell the customer.
containment.foot: Containment is complete when at least one action is done and none is open.

hold.subject: What is held
hold.reasonsFailed: The reasons could not be read.
hold.heldNoSubject: The NCR names no lot or work order to hold: place the hold on the goods' own record, then mark this done.
hold.heldReason: Pick why it is held first.
hold.heldPlace: Placing a hold needs the right to place holds (quality.holds.place).

addAction.title: Add a containment action
addAction.placeHold: Place the hold now (the action is done with it)
addAction.holdLater: The action stays open; mark it done naming its hold.
addAction.hint: The NCR's version is checked: if someone changed it meanwhile, it is read again.
addAction.doneHold: The hold is placed and the action is done.

done.title: Action {seq} done
done.evidenceHint: A note, or a photo of it: done needs its evidence.
done.holdNeeded: Holding stock names its hold: place it here.
done.heldEvidence: Say what was done, or add a photo of it first.

cancelAction.title: Cancel this action
cancelAction.body: A cancelled action stays in the list with its reason as its evidence.

carryKind.stock: Carried out by its stock move.
carryKind.repair: Carried out by naming its repair.
carryKind.claim: Carried out with its supplier claim.
carryKind.stockAndClaim: Carried out by its stock move and its supplier claim.
carryKind.rework: Carried out by its rework order.
carryKind.none: Moves no stock and opens no record: marked carried out.

disposition.label: Decisions
disposition.emptyBody: Split the quantity across rework, repair, second quality, return to supplier, scrap or use as is.
disposition.approvalHint: A decision that needs approval is approved here by another person with the right to approve (quality.ncr.approve): never by who decided it.
disposition.waitingHint_one: {count} decision waits here for another person's approval (quality.ncr.approve; four eyes).
disposition.waitingHint_other: {count} decisions wait here for another person's approval (quality.ncr.approve; four eyes).
disposition.foot: The NCR is decided when the whole quantity is decided and approved; it closes when every decision is carried out.
disposition.gapsTitle_one: {count} decision cannot be carried out from here:
disposition.gapsTitle_other: {count} decisions cannot be carried out from here:

decide.title: Decide on {number}
decide.codesFailed: The disposition codes could not be read.
decide.asIsRefused: Use as is is refused on a {severity} NCR (a critical defect is never accepted).
decide.approvalHint: Whether it needs approval follows the code's rule (severity or value); the factory says so once it is saved.
decide.heldQuantity: Say the quantity (above 0, at most 4 decimals).

carry.title: Carry out decision {seq}: {code}
carry.stockFailed: The stock could not be read.
carry.total: {total} of {quantity} chosen: the moves add up to the decision.
carry.sitesFailed: The places could not be read.
carry.repairSearch: Search repairs by number or serial
carry.repairsFailed: The repairs could not be read (sales.repairs.view).
carry.repairsNone: No open repair: make it in Sales first, then name it here.
carry.claimOpenHint: A draft, sent later from Purchasing › Returns & claims.
carry.claimReasonsFailed: The claim reasons could not be read.
carry.claimsFailed: The supplier's claims could not be read.
carry.claimsNone: The supplier has no open claim on this lot.
carry.claimDraft: Nothing is sent to the supplier from here.
carry.heldNoPlaces: None of these goods lie in stock at this site: nothing to move.
carry.heldLines: Say how much moves from at least one place.
carry.heldLineQuantity: Each quantity: above 0, at most 4 decimals.
carry.heldClaimLot: The NCR names no lot: a claim opened here needs the lot whose goods go back.
carry.gapGarmentScrap: Garments still in work have no stock to move: remove this decision, decide Rework instead and create the rework order with "Scrap them all".
carry.gapNoStock: The NCR names no lot or material in stock: there is nothing to move from here.
carry.gapNoWorkOrder: The NCR names no work order: name it on Problem & evidence first.
carry.gapNoSupplier: The NCR names no supplier: a claim needs one.

rework.title: Create rework order
rework.body: A rework of {quantity} on work order {number}, opened for this NCR and carried out with it.
rework.operationsFailed: The work order's operations could not be read.
rework.reinspection: The reworked garments are inspected again before release.
rework.done: Decision {seq}: the rework order is open.
rework.scrapAll: Scrap them all (garments still in work)
rework.scrapAllHint: The rework order is recorded done at once with every garment scrapped: its scrap goes to the cost ledger as the rework's.
rework.doneScrap: Decision {seq}: the garments are scrapped through their rework order.

remove.title: Remove decision {seq}
remove.body: {code} · {quantity} goes back to what is left to decide.

linked.intro: Everything this NCR touches. Unlinking is kept in Activity; the source stays linked.
linked.holdsHint: The holds this NCR decides close with it; close one now before its goods are issued.
linked.follow: Rework orders, repairs and supplier claims
linked.followNone: None yet: carrying a decision out links them.
linked.capaNone: Not escalated to a CAPA: use ⋯ Escalate to CAPA… in the band.

link.title: Link a record
link.searchHint: Lots, hides, work orders, orders, shipments, receipts, styles (at least 2 characters).

closeHold.title: Close this hold now
closeHold.body: The hold is decided by this NCR: closed now (before its goods are issued), its work orders are lifted.

cancelNcr.title: Cancel {number}
cancelNcr.body: Only an NCR with nothing carried out is cancelled. Its holds stay active: release them on each hold's record.

register.title: Open the PPE register entry
register.body: A nonconformity of {style} that may present a risk goes to the PPE register (Reg. (EU) 2016/425 art. 8(4)).
register.done: The PPE register entry is open and linked.

file.notOpened: The file could not be opened.

report.none: No version kept yet: ⋯ Keep a version of the report.
report.hint: The report never shows a cost, a worker or the customer's concession. Sharing it with a supplier or a customer comes with the portal.
report.kept: Version {version} of the report is kept.
report.same: The report has not changed: version {version} stays the current one.
report.notKept: The report could not be kept.

escalate.heldElsewhere: Escalated to a CAPA you do not see.
escalate.heldCancelled: A cancelled NCR is not escalated.

cost.title: Cost of this NCR
cost.body: Material, labour, rework time, scrap value and freight: computed from the decisions and the rework, or typed. Seen only with the cost grain.
cost.forbidden: You need the cost grain to see costs
cost.forbiddenBody: An NCR's cost is shown only to people whose role sees costs (the cost grain) at its site.
cost.failed: The cost could not be read.
cost.upToDate: The computed lines are up to date.
cost.heldAdding: Finish the line you are writing first.
cost.stale: The computed lines are not up to date: {add} to add, {change} changed, {remove} gone. Compute again.
cost.waitingRework: its scrap is not in the cost ledger yet.
cost.waitingDecision: its goods are not valued yet (computed once carried out or once the stock has a value).
cost.emptyBody: Add a line, or compute the lines from the decisions and the rework.
cost.label: Cost lines
cost.chargeBody: A debit note to the supplier comes with Finance. Today the supplier claim of a "Return to supplier" decision asks for a credit.
cost.chargeHeld: There are no debit notes yet: open the supplier claim from a "Return to supplier" decision to ask for a credit.
cost.foot: Labour shows its total only, never a rate. Amounts never reach the floor, a supplier or a customer.
cost.heldClosed: The NCR is closed: its cost never changes.
cost.heldCancelled: The NCR is cancelled: its cost never changes.
cost.notAdded: The cost line could not be added.
cost.notSaved: The cost line could not be saved.
cost.notRemoved: The cost line could not be removed.
cost.notComputed: The cost could not be computed again.
cost.computedDone: The computed lines are up to date.
cost.typedHint: Typed by a person: it saves line by line.
cost.waitingTitle_one: One record is not valued yet

concession.title: Concession asked of the customer
concession.body: Ask the customer to accept a deviation; record their written answer with its file. Their own link page comes with the portal.
concession.foot: Nothing is sent to the customer from here: ask them by mail or on the thread, then record their answer.
concession.askBody: A concession is never asked on a critical NCR. The customer is told by you: this records the ask.
concession.customersFailed: The customers could not be read.
concession.askHint: What the customer is asked to accept (for example "Shade slightly darker").
concession.proposalHint: A discount, a delivery as they are, a later replacement…
concession.acceptedHint: They accept the deviation as proposed.
concession.refusedHint: They refuse it: say why, in their words.
concession.fileHint: A PDF or a photo of their answer: kept with the concession.
concession.heldClosed: The NCR is closed: no concession is asked any more.
concession.heldCancelled: The NCR is cancelled: no concession is asked.
concession.heldCritical: A critical defect is never sold under a concession (safety rule).
concession.heldNoParties: Asking a concession needs parties.view to pick the customer.
concession.heldAnsweredBy: Write who answered for the customer.
concession.heldAnswered: The answer is recorded already: it never changes.
concession.asked: The concession is recorded as asked.
